investigation_notes.Description: An Azure network change was detected that delete the virtual network peering named peering-to-central-soc for vnet-tallinn-prod-01. The operation was performed by andrus.kivi@globalcorp.ee, a user with Contributor role, from IP 194.126.101.99 in Tallinn, Estonia, and it completed successfully. While this is a sensitive connectivity modification, MFA is present and the user appears to be an authorized administrator with no obvious credential abuse in the available evidence. The activity is considered Low Priority as there is a plausible legitimate business justification and no corroborating indicators of compromise in the data provided.
